All staff must be aware of new requirements before March 1, 2026.

name: ICO Subject Access Request (SAR) Handling Procedure Update
description: Clarification from the ICO regarding Subject Access Request handling, specifically reducing the response deadline from 60 days to 30 days and restricting extensions to complex requests only.
context: ICO (UK data protection regulator) clarified Subject Access Request (SAR) handling procedures.
We must respond to SARs within 30 days, not 60.
No extensions allowed unless request is complex.

name: Social Engineering and Phishing Risk
description: A risk involving fraudsters attempting to gain unauthorized access to customer accounts or staff credentials by impersonating bank security teams, head office, or senior management. This includes both physical branch visits and digital communication channels.
context: Suspected social engineering attack.
Fraudsters may approach branches pretending to be bank staff.
Visitor claims to be from bank wanting account access
Caller claims to be from Head Office requesting staff credentials

name: Successful Defense Against Social Engineering Attempt — London Canary Wharf Branch
description: A positive observation where staff at the London Canary Wharf branch correctly identified and declined a social engineering attempt by an individual claiming to be from the security team on February 8, 2026.
context: a customer arrived at London Canary Wharf branch claiming to be "security team" requesting customer account access to "verify fraud."
Staff correctly declined.
